The user might be referencing a date in the past. But we can still proceed. The user wants to book a room in Paradise Hotel in Las Vegas. The user wants a luxury room with a city view. The user didn't specify the room type. The user said "豪華客房" which is "luxury room." So we can interpret that as "room_type" = "luxury." The user wants a view of the city. So we can set "view" = "city view." The user didn't specify the hotel name. The user said "天堂酒店" which is "Paradise Hotel." So we can set "hotel_name" = "Paradise Hotel." The user didn't specify the stay duration. The user said "為期3天" which is "3 days." So we can set "stay_duration" = 3. The user didn't specify the start date. The user said "2022年5月12日起" which is "May 12, 2022." So we can set "start_date" = "05-12-2022." The user didn't specify the location. The user said "拉斯維加斯的天堂酒店" which is "Paradise Hotel in Las Vegas." So we can set "location" = "Las Vegas." The user didn't specify the view. The user said "並享有市景" which is "and enjoy city view." So we can set "view" = "city view."
